subject: sounds
title: Add a Sound
about: Hear a word, add one sound to the front or the end, and tap the new word: mile with sss in front is smile, moo with nnn on the end is moon. Adding a sound is the partner of Take a sound away and sits at the top of NC RF.1.3 phonological awareness (NC lists no separate sub-code for it), because he must hold the old word in mind and blend the new sound onto it, building on RF.1.3.b.
tip: Say the new sound, then the old word, then run them together faster and faster until the new word pops out.

cards.q: Add the /s/ sound to the front of mile. What word do you get?
cards.sayQ: Add the sss sound to the front of mile. What word do you get?

cards.q: Add the /s/ sound to the front of nail. What word do you get?
cards.sayQ: Add the sss sound to the front of nail. What word do you get?

cards.q: Add the /s/ sound to the front of tar. What word do you get?
cards.sayQ: Add the sss sound to the front of tar. What word do you get?
cards.note: sss plus tar: star. Tar is the black sticky stuff on roads.

cards.q: Add the /f/ sound to the front of lag. What word do you get?
cards.sayQ: Add the fff sound to the front of lag. What word do you get?

cards.q: Add the /b/ sound to the front of us. What word do you get?
cards.sayQ: Add the buh sound to the front of us. What word do you get?

cards.q: Put /p/ at the beginning of lay. What new word is it?
cards.sayQ: Put puh at the beginning of lay. What new word is it?

cards.q: Put /d/ at the beginning of rip. What new word is it?
cards.sayQ: Put duh at the beginning of rip. What new word is it?

cards.q: What word do you get if you add /f/ to the start of ox?
cards.sayQ: What word do you get if you add fff to the start of ox?

cards.q: What word do you get if you add /p/ to the start of ink?
cards.sayQ: What word do you get if you add puh to the start of ink?

cards.q: Add the /n/ sound to the end of moo. What word do you get?
cards.sayQ: Add the nnn sound to the end of moo. What word do you get?
cards.note: moo plus nnn at the end: moon.

cards.q: Add the /t/ sound to the end of boo. What word do you get?
cards.sayQ: Add the tuh sound to the end of boo. What word do you get?
cards.note: boo plus tuh at the end: boot.

cards.q: Add the /d/ sound to the end of see. What word do you get?
cards.sayQ: Add the duh sound to the end of see. What word do you get?
cards.note: see plus duh at the end: seed.

cards.q: Add the /p/ sound to the end of so. What word do you get?
cards.sayQ: Add the puh sound to the end of so. What word do you get?
cards.note: so plus puh at the end: soap.

cards.q: Put /t/ at the end of an. What new word is it?
cards.sayQ: Put tuh at the end of an. What new word is it?
cards.note: an plus tuh at the end: ant.

cards.q: Put /n/ at the end of bar. What new word is it?
cards.sayQ: Put nnn at the end of bar. What new word is it?
cards.note: bar plus nnn at the end: barn.

cards.q: Put /s/ at the end of hat. What new word is it?
cards.sayQ: Put sss at the end of hat. What new word is it?
cards.note: hat plus sss at the end: hats. More than one hat.
